title: Palantir deep dive - In-Q-Tel lineage, product lines, government & foreign deployments, the data-fusion web
source: Primary/public record: In-Q-Tel investment history; USASpending/FPDS federal contract records; SEC filings (PLTR); UK NHS Federated Data Platform award (~GBP 330M, 2023); DoD/Army (incl. Project Maven successors), ICE (FALCON/ISAP), HHS (HHS Protect / Tiberius), IRS reporting 2025; company disclosures. Structural overlay only; every edge graded in its note. Deep-webbing block for the Palantir/surveillance epic (#216). More webbing to follow.

edges.notes: In-Q-Tel (CIA venture arm) was an early investor/customer that helped seed Palantir (~2005) and shaped Gotham for the IC (fact).
Alex Karp is co-founder and CEO of Palantir (fact).
Foundry - the commercial/enterprise + government data-integration platform (fact).
AIP - the Artificial Intelligence Platform layer (2023+) wiring LLMs onto Gotham/Foundry (fact).
ICE/HSI used Palantir case-management/analytics (FALCON) and ISAP-adjacent tooling; contracts renewed across administrations (fact).
Army adopted Palantir for intelligence data (won a competition vs the Army's DCGS-A; later Vantage/NGC2 work) (fact).
HHS used Palantir for HHS Protect / Tiberius (COVID data + vaccine allocation, 2020-21) (fact).
2025 reporting: Palantir engaged to help build/integrate IRS data systems (contested-scope; details evolving).
Palantir won the NHS England Federated Data Platform (~GBP 330M, Nov 2023), controversial on patient-data grounds (fact).
NHS England is the UK government health body (fact).
Palantir software reported in use for battlefield/targeting data in Ukraine (fact of deployment; operational specifics contested).
Palantir has participated in DoD/DARPA-adjacent data programs (fact, general).
Palantir's AIP integrates commercial LLMs (e.g., via Azure OpenAI / model partners) into its stack (fact; specific model mix varies).
Palantir announced availability of Anthropic's Claude models within its platform for government/defense customers (2024) (fact).
Thiel's Founders Fund is part of the founding/early-capital network around Palantir (fact of network; treat as affiliation, not a live financial edge here).
